scope: offline synthetic encoded-evidence collection; no diagnosis, clinical urgency or care recommendations

answers.binary: only encoded bare evidence is true; absence never false
answers.categorical: one exact typed source value, including explicit default/NA
answers.multichoice: one question reveals the complete encoded typed set; preserve explicit default/NA even if mixed; no inferred negatives
answers.default_usefulness: explicit nondefault values count as useful encoded content, not medical utility; default/NA remains confirmed with zero reward
answers.case_unavailable: no inferred demographics, pregnancy, postpartum or answers

eligibility.missing_parent_policy: globally exclude child; never invent parent, alias or activation
eligibility.self_root: eligible unless already disclosed/asked or contradictory
eligibility.known_parent: child eligible only after confirmed boolean true parent; UNKNOWN/false/conflict blocks
eligibility.unexpected_graph: abort before fitting if graph/types/hashes differ
eligibility.initial: only original INITIAL_EVIDENCE; abort if quarantined or unsupported

model_inputs: eligibility computed from public graph and disclosed state
forbidden: diagnoses or severity in model features/targets
future/hidden answers in features or masks
case/group/partition IDs or fingerprint bytes in features
validation/test rows for prefixes, preprocessing, priors or fitting
information.public_transcript: canonical JSON of initial evidence, explicit AGE/SEX, asked order, disclosed ID/state/typed values and contradiction state; no oracle, source IDs, labels or unasked values; SHA-256 transiently computed from this state only
information.feature_kind: kind is omitted from v1 model tokens because the existing selector view does not expose it; never infer kind from ID

overlap.fingerprint: active-interview-v1; canonical UTF-8 JSON sorted keys compact separators allow_nan=false; AGE float, SEX, INITIAL_EVIDENCE and sorted [active evidence ID, typed value] pairs; M values sorted by typed JSON; SHA-256 hex
overlap.reference: training-only unique fingerprint dictionary, sealed externally before validation/test outcomes
overlap.full_reports: retain every original source row including duplicates, with source membership unchanged
overlap.sensitivity: validation/test exclude only fingerprints present in sealed training reference; report full and sensitivity separately
overlap.within_training: one earliest-source-row representative per active fingerprint for capped fitting; full source remains unchanged
overlap.validation_selection: only non-training-overlap validation subset; no test-based exclusions
overlap.validation_test_overlap: not removed by training-only rule; report residual overlap and do not claim complete independence
overlap.prior_task3_fingerprints: cached descriptive evidence only; active fingerprint differs; no new overlap counts claimed now
overlap.storage: private SQLite/reference/row maps external only; no public fingerprint bytes

prefixes.case_order: ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 1729|fit|<active fingerprint>, earliest source ordinal breaks ties
prefixes.trajectory_seed: SHA256 of UTF-8 1729|prefix|<policy>|<public transcript SHA256>|<turn>; first 16 hex digits as unsigned integer
prefixes.candidate_order: ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 1729|candidate|<policy>|<public transcript SHA256>|<turn>|<evidence ID>; first 32 eligible; never case/oracle fingerprint
prefixes.targets: 1 iff eligible question has at least one explicitly encoded nondefault value; otherwise 0 (zero is collection utility, never a negative clinical answer)
prefixes.no_target_sampling: do not use oracle to choose trajectories, lengths, candidate sample or saved-prefix positions
prefixes.zero_positive_prefix: retain eligible sampled candidates with target 0; do not invent a positive or oracle stop
prefixes.stream_order: case sampling order, then declared policy order, then ascending saved turn, then candidate digest/ID order; skip unsaved turns after structural stops; never oracle-completion padding

stopping.question_cost: one per evidence ID, including M set; no repeat
stopping.unknown: disclosed unknown remains asked, not re-eligible; unknown answer alone does not stop
stopping.policy_stop: no learned stop or score threshold; continue if eligible until budget
stopping.failure: invalid/repeated/ineligible policy output is a recorded failed trajectory; no oracle retry or silent fallback

baselines.lexical: lexicographically smallest eligible ID by Unicode code-point order
baselines.random_eligible: uniform index into sorted eligible IDs; SHA256-seeded random.Random.randrange; seed material 1729|eval|random|<public transcript SHA256>|<turn>
baselines.training_frequency: descending useful-encoded frequency per active ID from the same capped 4096 training representatives; ties lexical; eligibility always enforced

ranking_model.training: partial_fit fixed prefix/candidate stream order, classes [0,1], no shuffle; reset estimator per alpha; both classes required globally or abort

tokens: candidate x each disclosed evidence ID/state/typed value token
features.multichoice: one typed value token per explicitly disclosed M member plus state token; no hidden count or unasked value token
features.normalisation: exact JSON-array token grammar in questioning_protocol.feature_tokens; typed_key compact sorted-key ASCII-escaped JSON, no learned vocabulary/imputation/scaler

selection.validation_order: ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 1729|select|<active fingerprint>; earliest source ordinal representative; no outcome-dependent sample
selection.primary: macro useful-encoded recall@20, cases with positive denominator only
selection.no_valid_support: abort if no supported positive-denominator validation cases or reference/membership verification fails
selection.test: one sealed final evaluation campaign for fixed three baselines and validation-selected ranker; no candidate grid or test retuning
pre_test_seal: training reference and selected fitting membership hashes
all alpha validation results and selected alpha
test outcome files must not yet exist
selection.no_post_selection_refit: retain train-only selected estimator; no validation refit or extra fit cases
selection.test_aggregation: one trajectory per frozen policy/case, cached externally once; full/sensitivity/subgroups/bootstrap derive from the same cached trajectory, never a second policy evaluation

evaluation.useful_unit: one active evidence ID with true B or at least one C/M value not typed-equal to publisher default; initial excluded; never medical importance
evaluation.denominator: all useful active IDs excluding initial, including conditionally unreachable encoded items; unreachable count reported separately, not silently dropped
evaluation.zero_denominator: recall undefined; exclude from macro, report count; include all cases in cost/unknown/failure metrics
metrics: useful-recall curve mean over turns 1..20, final state carried forward after stop
unreachable useful IDs and quarantined encoded counts
micro per-type useful recall and yield with asked counts and interview support
evaluation.stopped_tail: carry final disclosed state to later fixed budgets, including failures; report failures, no row dropping

subgroups.observed_unknown_rate: descriptive only; never selection feature from future turns
subgroups.support: always report n; suppress subgroup rates/intervals below 50 cases or 20 positive-denominator cases

uncertainty.interval: paired percentile 2.5/97.5 bootstrap, clusters sampled with replacement and all original rows retained within cluster; sensitivity reported separately
uncertainty.rare_groups: undefined metrics stay null; no zero substitution or clinical claims
uncertainty.undefined: use only defined replicate metrics for percentiles; suppress interval if fewer than 950/1000 are defined; report valid counts, never zero-fill

evaluation.diagnosis: optional aggregate label support only, no diagnosis accuracy/urgency metrics; labels never choose questions
evaluation.all_encoded_denominator: all explicitly encoded active IDs excluding initial, including defaults and conditionally unreachable items; one ID per question
evaluation.failure_accounting: stop on invalid/repeated/ineligible output, retain last valid state in all denominators and carry forward; nonfinite model score aborts the campaign, not a negative/unknown answer

seeds.random_draw: int(first 16 hex SHA256(seed-prefix UTF-8),16); random.Random(seed).randrange(len(sorted eligible)); no Python hash()
seeds.noninterference: Selector RNG/candidate subsampling use disclosed-transcript digest only, never case fingerprint, row ordinal, hidden answers, diagnosis or partition.

environment.environment_mutation: none in Task 3.5; separate external research env for future execution

gates.decision: GO frozen restricted synthetic evidence-collection protocol; implementation parity and pre-fit verification required before separately authorised training
gates.source_semantics: five orphan histories remain unresolved and excluded, not reconstructed
gates.independence: training-overlap sensitivity does not remove all validation/test/template dependence
gates.clinical: NO-GO; no clinical urgency labels or India-specific validation
gates.task_boundary: no training, LLM, app, ADR or NHAMCS changes
pre_fit_checks: training-only active fingerprint reference and selected source ordinal map sealed
prefix/mask/features pass synthetic leakage and deterministic replay parity
both utility-target classes and eligible validation positive-denominator support exist
all warnings/failures/durations and dependency versions recorded; nonfinite fits/scores abort before test
any incomplete/failed required alpha experiment blocks pre-test sealing; no replacement family/grid or test access
